faehigkeiten.grund: Auslieferung wird je Abruf neu zusammengesetzt (megaphone vergibt je Abruf eine request_event_id, megaphone haengt ein timetoken an, Adresse traegt eine session_id, kein ETag und Cache-Control "max-age=0, no-cache, no-store", Abruf laeuft ueber den Werbedienst megaphone.fm) - Byte-Offsets veralten (bei dynamischer Auslieferung sofort, gemessen 19.08.2026) und die Zeitachse verschiebt sich mit (eine Folge war 57 s kuerzer als 3,5 h zuvor), deshalb sind auch Sprungmarken in Sekunden unsicher

einzeiler: An immersive audio adaptation of Jane Austen's classic novel Emma, narrated by Julie…
kurzfassung: Julie Andrews narrates this immersive audio version of Jane Austen's classic novel about the clever and wealthy Emma Woodhouse. Following the marriage of her beloved governess, Emma faces intellectual solitude while indulging her passion for matchmaking. Her well-meaning interference draws sharp criticism from Mr. Knightley, yet she remains undeterred in her plans.
stichpunkte: Introduction to Emma Woodhouse, a wealthy, clever, and self-satisfied young woman living at Hartfield.
The departure of Emma's governess and companion, Miss Taylor, after marrying Mr. Weston.
Mr. Woodhouse's nervous disposition and constant lamenting over any form of change.
Mr. Knightley visits Hartfield and challenges Emma's self-appointed matchmaking successes.
Emma proudly defends her role in orchestrating the match between Miss Taylor and Mr. Weston.
Despite warnings from her father and Mr. Knightley, Emma sets her sights on matchmaking for Mr. Elton.
Background details reveal Mr. Weston's past marriage into the wealthy Churchill family and his son Frank.
The community of Highbury eagerly anticipates a visit and polite letter from the newly adult Frank Churchill.

clips.hook: The real evils of Emma's situation
clips.text: The primary drawbacks in the protagonist's life stem from having excessive personal freedom and an overly inflated opinion of herself.

clips.hook: How am I to get so far?
clips.text: The nervous father expresses utter bewilderment at the prospect of traveling a mere half-mile to visit the newly married couple.
The protagonist proudly claims full credit for orchestrating a marriage four years prior, much to the dismay of her father.

clips.hook: Only one more, papa, only for Mr. Elton
clips.text: Dismissing warnings against meddling, the young woman immediately resolves to find a wife for the local clergyman who has lived alone for a year.

clips.hook: The wedding cake, which had been a great distress to him
clips.text: The anxious father regards a festive baked good as a severe health hazard and attempts to prevent anyone from consuming it.

beschreibung:
This is a preview of a brand-new audiobook from the Noiser Podcast Network. Join Dame Julie Andrews as she reads another beloved Austen classic, Emma, on the Jane Austen Stories podcast.

Step into the village of Highbury, home to the handsome and clever Emma Woodhouse.

As new visitors arrive and quiet mysteries unfold, what will our heroine learn both of the secrets of others and of her own heart's desires?

For more episodes, search for Jane Austen Stories in your podcast app and hit follow, or head to www.noiser.com
